(3) https://gas.in-en.com/html/gas-2699330.shtml (cited for Length=8km, Diameter=273mm, Pressure=6.3MPa) returned HTTP 403 on every fetch attempt (tool WebFetch, curl with browser UA + referer) — completely unreachable/unverifiable by any method tried. Net result: the row's entire citation set fails to substantively confirm existence, status, or any spec value for this specific 8km/273mm segment. Xingye County itself is real and plausibly within Guangxi's broader county-level gas-branch build-out, so this is flagged as a sourcing/existence concern rather than a confident 'this pipeline is fake' call — but as currently cited, none of Status=operating, StartYear1=2023, Length=8km, Diameter=273mm, Pressure=6.3MPa, Fuel=Gas, PipelineType=transmission, or ProposalYear=2021 is actually supported by a working, on-topic, independent source.
